email.subject: Honey Co Hair Studio: quick site fix list
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I checked Honey Co Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no booking option, so anyone browsing on their phone (most people) can't actually book a cut without calling. On top of that, the site has no listed hours and the images are slow to load, which doesn't help either.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change and why.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
